issues.title: Eliminate @ts-ignore in AdminGameSetup Component
issues.body:
## 🐞 Amendment description
The `AdminGameSetup` component currently uses `@ts-ignore` in several places. This is not a recommended practice as it suppresses TypeScript errors without providing a proper solution. We need to refactor the code to eliminate the usage of `@ts-ignore` and implement TypeScript-friendly solutions.


## 🖥️ Screenshots
![393a98d96d2307b448cfedeecca32fa6](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/20753599/b5ab9114-6836-4990-914d-fa75d5a9949e)
